subline: A two-day jam program for Perth musos aged 14–17. Write an original song. Play it as a band.

infoRows.label: Where
infoRows.value: Player 1 Music School, 5 Woodville Lane, North Perth

priceExplainer: Our first-ever jam program, so we've set the price low on purpose.

scholarship.heading: Cost shouldn't decide this.
scholarship.body: If $80 is a stretch, email Dave and we'll sort a partial or full place. No questions asked, no awkwardness.

benefits.headline: Write a Song From Scratch
benefits.body: Two days, one original, with musos you've only just met.

benefits.headline: Keep the Recording
benefits.body: You'll walk out with your song. Yours forever.

benefits.headline: Find Out What You've Got
benefits.body: You'll learn things about your playing you didn't know were there.

benefits.headline: Maybe Find Your Band
benefits.body: A lot of first bands start in a room exactly like this.

reassurance: No judgement.  No benchmarks.  No solo pressure.

quote.text: It wasn't footy after school — it was making music. I had people to relate to. I belonged somewhere. And I could do it without anyone telling me how. That's what I want for today's kids.
